protocol.algorithm_name: P2 structural frontier with guarded active-core choice
protocol.method_description: One structural wave plan with guarded active-core choice; component fallback defers balance-only splitting. No stored scores or online evaluation.
protocol.case_selection: Fixed shard 1 covers cases 001-025 at every core 1-5; no historical selection.
protocol.failure_policy: First failed or unverified cell writes shared stop marker; other shards stop before their next cell; no retry.
protocol.resources: Four independent one-worker shards; each driver process tree sampled at 900 MiB, sum of caps <4 GiB; shared-host timing not exclusive.
protocol.offline_costs: Earlier 044/k4 pilot remains independent; this fixed full500 batch reruns all cells from cold process.
protocol.comparison: Against fixed ee1 pilot00b7065e: 044/k4 M66901, extra DDR2791200B, spill0. Fang fixed4-core-budget result44234 used2activecores; a reference not a source of plan selection.

timing.evaluation_precision: perf_counter seconds; ps observer and cleanup overhead included

solver.method: One structural wave plan with guarded active-core choice; component fallback defers balance-only splitting. No stored scores or online evaluation.

environment.gpu: not used; CPU-only Python solver and official evaluator
environment.dependencies: uv.lock sha256=7b03fee57044ac272d8895533cbdca6d70a29d2da955f98a5552e72ef944fdc4; uv sync --locked prepared before this run; no compilation/training

measurement.solver_scope: Fresh Python process launch through observed exit and owned-descendant cleanup; input, construction and any online scoring included. OS caches not flushed; concurrent machine load not isolated.
measurement.evaluation_scope: Zero online E0. The reported evaluation_wall_seconds is the separate final E0 outside solver wall; no online result exists to compare.
measurement.offline_costs: Earlier 044/k4 pilot remains independent; this fixed full500 batch reruns all cells from cold process.

notes: Producer evidence and format checks are not central import or scientific acceptance.
Subprocess/RSS observations can miss short peaks. All dispatched failures remain in the journal; no automatic retry.
Direct mode uses zero online E0; independently reported final E0 is outside solver wall.

Four fixed disjoint 125-cell shards form one source version; previous 044/k4 pilot is not reused. Each solver launched a separate final official P2 E0. Shared-host concurrency is recorded separately from solver wall.

The matrix runner environment reports Python 3.14.5; the recorded solver and official E0 argv both use .venv/bin/python, prepared by uv sync --locked and verified as Python 3.12.13. The environment field describes the outer runner, not the solver interpreter.
